name: modrixcommerce/gdpr-cookie-consent
description: Shows a cookie-consent banner to visitors from the EU, EEA, the UK and Switzerland so the store can lawfully set marketing and analytics cookies. Records each consent decision (accept, reject or custom categories) for your accountability records.
author: Modrix team

settings.label: Who sees the banner
settings.help: GDPR only: EU/EEA, UK and Switzerland. Everyone: all visitors, wherever they are.

settings.label: Message
settings.help: Explain what cookies you set and why. Link to your privacy page from here.
settings.default: We use cookies to make the site work and, with your consent, to understand how it is used and to show relevant offers. You can accept all cookies or choose which categories to allow.

settings.label: Privacy policy link
settings.help: Optional path such as /page/privacy. Leave empty to hide the link.

settings.label: Offer category choices
settings.help: Show a second panel where visitors choose which cookie categories to allow.

settings.label: Essential cookies description
settings.default: Required for the store to work, such as your cart and sign-in. Always on.

settings.label: Analytics cookies description
settings.default: Help us understand how visitors use the site so we can improve it.

settings.label: Marketing cookies description
settings.default: Let us show relevant offers and measure our advertising.

settings.label: Consent lasts (days)
settings.help: How long the choice is remembered before the banner asks again.
